title: A common regular affine refinement around a point of the immersion
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion, U and Uprime affine opens of Y, and z in Z with i(z) in both opens. Suppose the ideal i.ker(U) is generated by a finite Koszul-regular sequence. There is an affine U0 containing i(z), contained in both U and Uprime, whose immersion ideal has finite Koszul-regular generators. Regularity of Uprime is not required.

source.place: Lemma 15.31.5, flat base change; Tag 01I1 proof for the distinguished-open basis; Tag 01HV (3)-(5) for localized sections.

proof.text: Choose s in Gamma(Y,U) with i(z) in D(s)⊆Uprime using IsAffineOpen.exists_basicOpen_le. D(s) is contained in U and is affine. Equip its section ring with the restriction-map algebra structure. IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_basicOpen identifies this ring as the away localization; IsLocalization.flat gives flatness.

Restrict the given generators using the algebra map. Apply isKoszulRegular_of_flat. The ideal generated by their images is the map of the original span, by Ideal.map_span and Set.range_comp; IdealSheafData.map_ideal identifies this with the immersion ideal of D(s). Assemble the membership and inclusion witnesses.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulRegularImmersion_affine_refinement
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (U U' : Y.affineOpens) (z : Z) (hz : i z ∈ U.1) (hz' : i z ∈ U'.1)
    (hU : ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Γ(Y, U.1)),
      Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
        RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) :
    ∃ U₀ : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U₀.1 ∧ U₀.1 ≤ U.1 ∧ U₀.1 ≤ U'.1 ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Γ(Y, U₀.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U₀ ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f
